reconciliation_notes: Empirically verified. Corrected sum(diff^2)=0.808044 vs power_ref=62.95629 yields 18.92 dB. Consistent with Pearson r=0.98418 and RMSE=0.002923.

claim_description: ONNX subgraph equivalence of ~118 dB SDR

claim_description: Step-500 algorithmic latency is 10.0 ms or 20.0 ms
reconciliation_notes: Step-500 config has conv_lookahead=2 and df_lookahead=2. Algorithmic delay is 1 STFT overlap frame (10ms) + 2 lookahead frames (20ms) = 30.00 ms (1440 samples).
